items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 94:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the kisses? The coupling of the two inner Partzufim of ZA and his Nukva, called voice and speech, is discerned as the coupling of kisses within them. (Item 178).
